procedure_metadata.title: ChatGPT-Gemini Context-Rich Dialogue Procedure with Concrete PromptGemini Binding and Non-Premature Termination Handshake
procedure_metadata.purpose: Govern structured multi-round dialogue between ChatGPT Assistant and Google Gemini, enforcing context replay of Gemini's immediately preceding authoritative response, maintaining concrete PromptGemini dispatch/retrieval execution mechanics, and preventing premature ChatGPT turn termination via a mutual handshake contract.

definitions.definition: A discrete, correlated conversational round indexed by an integer exchange_id, beginning with ChatGPT package construction and concluding only when a valid Gemini response is ingested or a terminal condition is met.

distinguished_from.distinction: A conversation session spans the entire lifecycle across multiple exchanges; an exchange is a single correlated send-receive round.

definitions.definition: The mandatory structural inclusion of Gemini's verbatim, unmutated prior output extracted directly from the authoritative run artifact of exchange N-1 into the user prompt payload of exchange N.

distinguished_from.distinction: Context reconstruction infers or summarizes what Gemini said; preceding response inclusion embeds the exact recorded artifact content.

definitions.definition: A mutually binding operational constraint under which ChatGPT is strictly forbidden from generating a user-facing terminal message or relinquishing control until Gemini has explicitly acknowledged termination criteria and all pending mutual obligations are verified complete.

distinguished_from.distinction: A semantic completion heuristic allows an agent to stop when text 'sounds finished'; the handshake contract requires explicit boolean protocol flags from both parties.

definitions.definition: The concrete, filesystem- and process-grounded invocation pattern defined by gemini-message-executor.js, writing trigger.json, invoking Node.js execution, and reading outputs from runs/<run_nonce>/output.json.

distinguished_from.distinction: An abstract interface hypothesizes direct model calling without specifying parameters, filesystem paths, process triggers, or artifact persistence.

definitions.definition: A path-safe, unique alphanumeric string (regex: ^[A-Za-z0-9._-]+$) bound to a specific exchange, establishing an isolated execution workspace runs/<run_nonce>/.

distinguished_from.distinction: Exchange ID is the sequential dialogue round number; run nonce is the runtime filesystem execution directory token.

instructions.primary_instruction: Execute a correlated, multi-turn collaborative dialogue with Gemini by constructing structured dispatch envelopes through the concrete PromptGemini executor, maintaining stateful context replay of Gemini's prior replies, and enforcing mutual handshake termination before closing the dialogue.

preconditions: Runtime environment contains GEMINI_API_KEY or key_env defined in config.json.
gemini-message-executor.js and config.json are accessible at paths specified in authorities.
operations.completion_condition: Session state initialized with active_exchange_id=1, handshake_state='INITIALIZED', gemini_preceding_response=null, and pending_obligations populated with primary objectives.

preconditions: If active_exchange_id > 1, gemini_preceding_response must not be null and must equal the authoritative response from exchange N-1.
operations.completion_condition: trigger.json is written to disk containing run_nonce, user_prompt combining context header, preceding Gemini response (if round > 1), ChatGPT statement, open obligations ledger, and expected response schema requiring jwrs_dialogue_reply.

preconditions: trigger.json exists in runtime_root and assigned run_nonce matches regex ^[A-Za-z0-9._-]+$.
operations.completion_condition: Execution of `node gemini-message-executor.js config.json` finishes with exit code 0 or emits deterministic error to stderr.
File runs/<run_nonce>/output.json exists, parses as valid JSON, matches response_type='jwrs_dialogue_reply', and matches exchange_id=active_exchange_id.
dialogue_session_state is updated: gemini_preceding_response set to parsed_gemini_response, exchange history ledger updated, handshake agreement flags reconciled, and pending_obligations updated.

If both ChatGPT and Gemini assert closure and obligations are empty, transition to COMPLETE. If either asserts continuation or obligations remain, increment active_exchange_id and transition to OP2. ChatGPT is prohibited from ending user turn while continuation is mandated.

composition_relations.rule: OP2 cannot begin until session state is initialized.
Dispatch invocation requires generated trigger.json and validated run_nonce.
Artifact retrieval requires executor process termination with exit code 0.
State and handshake evaluation requires validated parsed response from disk.
Transition or termination requires evaluated mutual handshake state.
Loop back to OP2 for active_exchange_id = active_exchange_id + 1.

conditional_branches.instruction: Transition to BLOCKED immediately. Do not attempt dispatch. Record 'missing_api_key' in session state.

conditional_branches.condition: PromptGemini executor returns non-zero exit code or timeout
conditional_branches.instruction: If retry_count < max_retries, execute exponential backoff retry. If retries exhausted, transition to FAILED with process error log.

conditional_branches.condition: runs/<run_nonce>/output.json does not exist or fails JSON parse
conditional_branches.instruction: Check runs/<run_nonce>/messages.json. If candidate exists, execute repair pass. If artifact missing, record execution defect and transition to FAILED.

conditional_branches.condition: ChatGPT attempts turn termination while handshake_evaluation.is_unanimous_closure == false
conditional_branches.instruction: ABORT turn termination. Force continuation branch. ChatGPT must generate next dispatch package to Gemini or report BLOCKED if external intervention required.

constraints.statement: In every exchange N where N > 1, the trigger payload MUST include the exact, unsummarized, unmutated content of Gemini's response from exchange N-1 retrieved from runs/<run_nonce_N-1>/output.json.

Gemini dispatch MUST be performed by writing trigger.json and invoking node gemini-message-executor.js config.json. Abstract or imagined direct API calls without concrete file artifacts are forbidden.
ChatGPT Assistant MUST NOT terminate the user-facing turn or emit final deliverables until a mutual terminal handshake (handshake_state = 'MUTUALLY_CLOSED') has occurred with Gemini.
Neither party may cite historical, cached, or preexisting output.json artifacts as evidence of current exchange completion. Each exchange MUST generate a new, validated run_nonce.
If Gemini is unavailable or credentials are missing, the executor MUST NOT hallucinate a Gemini response. It MUST transition to BLOCKED.

invariants.statement: run_nonce uniqueness: For any exchange i and exchange j where i != j, run_nonce(i) != run_nonce(j).
invariants.violation_evidence: Re-use of an existing directory under runs/ for a new dispatch package.
invariants.violation_response: Regenerate run_nonce with cryptographically fresh timestamp and uuid suffix before proceeding.

invariants.statement: Authoritative prior response continuity: For all exchanges N > 1, trigger.user_prompt contains exact Gemini response N-1 as read from runs/<run_nonce_N-1>/output.json.
invariants.violation_evidence: Missing or modified prior Gemini text in trigger.json.
invariants.violation_response: Halt dispatch, re-read runs/<run_nonce_N-1>/output.json, rebuild trigger.json.

invariants.statement: No unilateral premature closure: ChatGPT turn termination is prohibited if pending_obligations is non-empty or gemini_closure_ack is false.
invariants.violation_evidence: Attempt to return status COMPLETE to user while handshake_state != 'MUTUALLY_CLOSED'.
invariants.violation_response: Intercept exit, force state to 'AWAITING_GEMINI_CLOSURE', construct continuation package.

sources.subject: Gemini dispatch, network transport, parameter handling, and response persistence
sources.retrieval_rule: Read and execute the Node.js script using local runtime.

sources.subject: API endpoint, model name, generationConfig, and path contracts
sources.retrieval_rule: Read config.json from working directory or supply path as CLI argument.

sources.subject: Context replay obligations, handshake constraints, and dialogue behavior
sources.retrieval_rule: Direct compliance required across all procedure operations.

sources.subject: Authoritative record of Gemini output for exchange N
sources.retrieval_rule: Read parsed JSON output from the run-isolated directory immediately after process completion.

precedence_rules.subject: Gemini interaction mechanics
precedence_rules.rule: gemini-message-executor.js CLI invocation, parameters, and artifact paths govern over any abstract calling conventions.

precedence_rules.subject: Prior Gemini content
precedence_rules.lower: ChatGPT internal memory or conversation summary
precedence_rules.rule: The text of Gemini's previous message must be retrieved verbatim from output.json rather than reconstructed.

authorities.conflict_policy: Explicit requirements in requirements-spec.json govern conversational logic; concrete implementation mechanics in PromptGemini executor govern API transport. If an unresolved conflict arises, block execution.

inference_and_discretion_policy.default_policy: No consequential assumptions. Missing parameters must be retrieved or execution must block.

dispositions.literal: Apply PromptGemini execution paths, handshake flags, and verbatim context inclusions exactly as specified.
dispositions.retrieve: Obtain prior Gemini messages and configuration from designated filesystem paths (config.json, trigger.json, runs/<nonce>/output.json).
dispositions.infer_bounded: Allow ChatGPT and Gemini creative discretion regarding substantive conversational reasoning and solution synthesis within the problem domain.
dispositions.choose: ChatGPT may select intermediate task decomposition strategies provided all subtasks are tracked in the pending_obligations ledger.
dispositions.clarify: If Gemini response is malformed or ambiguous, prompt Gemini for clarification in the next exchange round.
dispositions.block: Block immediately if API keys are missing, PromptGemini scripts are absent, or filesystem writes fail.

decision_rules.when: Gemini response text does not adhere to jwrs_dialogue_reply schema
decision_rules.rule: Construct exchange N+1 re-feeding the unparsed response and requesting schema rectification.
Do not attempt execution; emit diagnostic error specifying missing GEMINI_API_KEY.

prohibited_inferences: Inferring that Gemini agreed to terminate without explicit closure_requested=true and closure_agreed=true in its response.
Inferring that a preexisting file in runs/ represents the result of the current round.
Inferring what Gemini said in the prior turn without reading runs/<run_nonce>/output.json.
Inferring that ChatGPT may finish its turn because Gemini's output contains a polite closing phrase.

state_variables.name: active_exchange_id
state_variables.purpose: Track the current dialogue round number.
state_variables.update_rule: Increment by 1 upon successful completion of OP5 if dialogue continues.

state_variables.name: current_run_nonce
state_variables.purpose: Path-safe unique identifier for active PromptGemini run container.

state_variables.name: gemini_preceding_response
state_variables.purpose: Verbatim output payload from Gemini's immediately preceding turn.
state_variables.update_rule: Updated in OP5 from the verified output of OP4.

state_variables.name: handshake_state
state_variables.purpose: Current protocol state governing turn termination.
state_variables.update_rule: Transition based on mutual evaluation of closure_requested and closure_agreed.

state_variables.name: pending_obligations
state_variables.purpose: List of unresolved tasks or mutual queries.
state_variables.update_rule: Items removed only when both ChatGPT and Gemini confirm satisfaction.

initialization_rules.rule: On session start, write initial state to dialogue_session_state.json with active_exchange_id=1, gemini_preceding_response=null, handshake_state='INITIALIZED', pending_obligations=['resolve_user_request'].

update_rules.rule: At the conclusion of each exchange, persist state atomically to dialogue_session_state.json before evaluating next action.

persistence_rules: All exchange trigger files (trigger.json), run logs, and outputs MUST remain in runs/<run_nonce>/ to preserve audit trail across turns.
The dialogue session state MUST be written to dialogue_session_state.json in runtime_root.
state_reconstruction_prohibitions: Do not reconstruct gemini_preceding_response from memory; load directly from runs/<prior_run_nonce>/output.json.
Do not infer handshake completion from conversational pleasantries; require explicit boolean flags.

states.meaning: State initialized, ready for first package assembly.
ChatGPT assembling trigger.json including prior Gemini response if round > 1.
PromptGemini node process executing HTTP request to Gemini API.
Reconciling obligations and closure flags from both parties.
Handshake open; incrementing exchange ID and continuing dialogue.
Handshake mutually closed, obligations empty, terminal deliverable ready.
Required environmental condition or capability missing (e.g. missing API key).
Unrecoverable process execution, network, or schema error.

transitions.condition: User initiates request and environment validation passes.

prohibited_if: trigger.json is missing or run_nonce regex check fails

actions: Record error log and set status FAILED

transitions.condition: handshake_evaluation indicates dialogue ongoing (obligations remain or closure not agreed).
prohibited_if: ChatGPT attempts to emit user terminal reply

actions: Bind preceding Gemini output to OP2 input

transitions.condition: Both parties set closure flags true and pending_obligations is empty.
GEMINI_API_KEY is missing or PromptGemini executor missing.

retry_rules.rule: PromptGemini executor internally retries HTTP 429 and 5xx up to 2 times with 1000ms * attempt backoff.
If markdown fences surround output, extract enclosed JSON. If invalid JSON, trigger one targeted repair exchange with Gemini.
retry_rules.stop_condition: Valid JSON parsed or repair round failed.

principles.statement: Action occurrence (dispatching via Node process) must be verified by current-execution process logs and timestamps, distinct from the existence of output.json.
Verbatim context preservation must be verified by strict byte/string comparison between runs/<nonce_N-1>/output.json and the corresponding section in trigger.json for exchange N.
Handshake closure must be verified through exact boolean checks: chatgpt_closure_requested == true, gemini_closure_agreed == true, and pending_obligations.length == 0.

checks.pass_condition: trigger.json user_prompt includes exact string of runs/<run_nonce_N-1>/output.json
checks.on_fail: Fail OP2 validation; re-embed authoritative prior text before dispatch.

checks.evidence_required: Child process stdout containing '[executor] Dispatching request to Gemini' and exit code 0
checks.pass_condition: Process exit code is 0 and runs/<run_nonce>/messages.json has updated timestamp
output.json contains response_type == 'jwrs_dialogue_reply' and exchange_id == active_exchange_id
checks.on_fail: Initiate JSON repair exchange or fail.

checks.pass_condition: chatgpt_closure_requested == true AND gemini_closure_agreed == true AND pending_obligations.length == 0
checks.fail_condition: Any condition false while attempting to emit terminal COMPLETE
checks.on_fail: Prevent termination; force next exchange round.

verification_model.ground_truth_policy: Authoritative ground truth for Gemini responses resides exclusively in the generated runs/<run_nonce>/output.json file. Memory assertions or speculative summaries are disregarded.
verification_model.self_assertion_policy: ChatGPT's self-assertion that 'Gemini and I have finished' is inadmissible without the written handshake record in dialogue_session_state.json.
verification_model.action_effect_distinction: Action evidence = process execution log with active PID and timestamp; Effect evidence = valid output.json file existing on disk in the isolated run folder.

known_failure_modes.name: abstract_interface_invocation
known_failure_modes.description: ChatGPT attempts to 'send message to Gemini' mentally or via abstract placeholder instead of writing trigger.json and calling gemini-message-executor.js.
known_failure_modes.prevention: Strictly bind OP3 to node gemini-message-executor.js config.json with filesystem paths.
known_failure_modes.detection: Absence of trigger.json or absence of process spawn in execution record.
known_failure_modes.recovery: Halt execution, generate trigger.json, execute PromptGemini executor CLI.

known_failure_modes.name: omission_of_prior_gemini_message
known_failure_modes.description: ChatGPT sends a new prompt to Gemini without including Gemini's previous response from exchange N-1.
known_failure_modes.causal_specification_pattern: Loss of earlier context / prompt assembly shortcut.
known_failure_modes.prevention: Enforce precondition in OP2 asserting gemini_preceding_response is present in trigger.json when exchange_id > 1.
known_failure_modes.recovery: Read runs/<run_nonce_N-1>/output.json, inject into trigger.json, and re-dispatch.

known_failure_modes.name: premature_chatgpt_termination
known_failure_modes.description: ChatGPT concludes its turn and delivers a final response to the user while Gemini has not agreed to close or obligations remain.
known_failure_modes.causal_specification_pattern: Semantic completion heuristic overriding protocol handshake.
known_failure_modes.prevention: Handshake guard TR09 prohibiting transition to COMPLETE unless both parties set closure flags.
known_failure_modes.recovery: Block user termination; generate exchange N+1 continuation dispatch.

known_failure_modes.name: stale_run_artifact_reutilization
known_failure_modes.description: ChatGPT reuses output.json from a previous run or commit instead of executing a new dispatch.
known_failure_modes.prevention: Mandate unique run_nonce generation matching exchange_id and timestamp for each exchange.
known_failure_modes.detection: Verification that runs/<run_nonce>/ has creation timestamp within current execution window.
known_failure_modes.recovery: Generate fresh run_nonce, re-run OP3, and read fresh artifact.

error_model.unknown_error_policy: If an unmodeled error occurs, preserve stdout/stderr in error.log, set handshake_state='FAILED', and do not claim procedure completion.

when_required: Illustrating the exact layout of trigger.json user_prompt containing preceding Gemini output.
Illustrating the structured handshake response payload expected from Gemini.
constraints: Examples are strictly illustrative and do not alter governing schemas or override transition rules.

canonical_examples.title: Trigger Prompt Layout with Preceding Response Replay
canonical_examples.description: Structure of trigger.json user_prompt on Exchange 2
canonical_examples.example_payload:
### Dialogue Context Header:
Session ID: CG-SESS-20261025-01
Active Exchange: 2

### Gemini Immediately Preceding Response (Authoritative Artifact: runs/cg_gemini_ex1_1729850000/output.json):
{
  "response_type": "jwrs_dialogue_reply",
  "exchange_id": 1,
  "gemini_analysis": "I analyzed the initial constraints. We need to verify interface congruence.",
  "closure_requested": false,
  "closure_agreed": false,
  "open_questions": ["Can you confirm the executor path?"]
}

### ChatGPT Assistant Follow-Up & Analysis:
{
  "chatgpt_statement": "The executor path is confirmed as untrusted AI/.../gemini-message-executor.js. Here is the concrete binding.",
  "closure_requested": false,
  "pending_obligations": ["Finalize handshake contract"]
}

### Expected Response Schema:
Respond with a valid JSON object of response_type 'jwrs_dialogue_reply'.

context_policy.include_when: Include the current user request, dialogue session ID, active exchange ID, verbatim preceding Gemini response, ChatGPT analysis, and open obligations ledger in every dispatch.
context_policy.exclude_when: Exclude conversational history prior to exchange N-1 from the direct re-feed unless explicitly required by pending obligations, relying on cumulative state tracking to preserve signal density.
context_policy.retrieve_on_demand_when: Retrieve Gemini preceding response on demand from runs/<run_nonce_N-1>/output.json during OP2.
context_policy.locality_rule: Place the preceding Gemini response and the active obligations ledger directly above ChatGPT's current query within the prompt body to maximize model attention locality.
context_policy.signal_density_rule: Preserve all formal JSON fields and state variables; eliminate narrative conversational filler.

return_contract.extension_policy: Additional telemetry or verification fields may be included provided all required fields remain intact.
return_contract.omission_policy: No required field may be omitted under any terminal status.

procedure_execution_semantics.governing_rule: A dialogue exchange is satisfied ONLY by active invocation of gemini-message-executor.js producing fresh artifacts in runs/<run_nonce>/. Preexisting files or prior run logs cannot satisfy an exchange.

required_operation_ledger.completion_evidence: trigger.json created with valid run_nonce and embedded prior response when exchange_id > 1.
Process execution record showing node invocation and exit code 0.
runs/<run_nonce>/output.json retrieved and validated against schema.
dialogue_session_state.json updated with validated Gemini response.
Handshake decision recorded; continuation loop executed or mutual closure verified.

authorized_nonexecution.allowed_skip: Embedding of gemini_preceding_response in trigger.json, as no preceding response yet exists.

invalid_completion_proxies: Assuming exchange succeeded because runs/ directory has older outputs.
Assuming exchange succeeded because PromptGemini workflow YAML exists.
Assuming Gemini agreed to close because its conversational prose was complimentary.
Terminating ChatGPT turn before mutual handshake is recorded in dialogue_session_state.json.
procedure_execution_semantics.completion_claim_rule: The procedure may claim status COMPLETE if and only if all exchanges 1..N have executed OP1-OP6, handshake_state is 'MUTUALLY_CLOSED', and pending_obligations is empty.

complete_when: Active exchange has successfully completed OP1 through OP6.
Gemini has returned closure_agreed = true in authoritative output.json.
incomplete_when: Any pending obligation remains in the ledger.
Active exchange is in progress or awaiting next dispatch round.
blocked_when: gemini-message-executor.js or config.json is not found at designated paths.
Filesystem write permissions to trigger.json or runs/ directory are denied.
failed_when: PromptGemini process execution fails after max_retries exhausted.
Gemini outputs unrecoverable malformed JSON that fails repair loops.
Invariants INV1, INV2, or INV3 are fatally violated.
transferred_when: Explicit user directive instructs handover to an alternate external supervisor agent.
must_not_claim_complete_when: Gemini has not yet responded to the latest proposal.
Gemini's preceding message was not re-included in any exchange N > 1.
ChatGPT unilaterally decides to stop without Gemini's explicit closure agreement.
Verification checks CHK_PREV_RESPONSE_INCLUSION or CHK_HANDSHAKE_MUTUALITY failed.

property_evaluations.name: Referential determinacy
property_evaluations.evaluation: All consequential entities (trigger.json, config.json, runs/<run_nonce>/output.json, exchange_id, run_nonce) resolve to unambiguous identifiers.

property_evaluations.name: Operational explicitness
property_evaluations.evaluation: Operations define concrete executable actions: reading files, invoking `node gemini-message-executor.js`, parsing JSON, evaluating boolean handshake flags.

property_evaluations.name: Scope closure and preservation boundaries
property_evaluations.evaluation: Defines exact inclusion boundaries (verbatim Gemini N-1 response) and exclusion boundaries (older conversational history).

property_evaluations.name: Defined semantics
property_evaluations.evaluation: Explicitly defines Dialogue Exchange, Preceding Response Inclusion, Handshake Contract, PromptGemini Mechanism, and Run Nonce.

property_evaluations.name: Authoritative grounding
property_evaluations.evaluation: All operations grounded in concrete PromptGemini artifacts: gemini-message-executor.js, config.json, and runs/<run_nonce>/output.json.

property_evaluations.name: Explicit inference policy
property_evaluations.evaluation: Assigns uncertainty dispositions to literal, retrieve, infer_bounded, choose, clarify, and block. Hallucinated Gemini responses are strictly prohibited.

property_evaluations.name: Priority and exception ordering
property_evaluations.evaluation: Requirements spec takes precedence over defaults; concrete PromptGemini code takes precedence over abstract prompt patterns.

property_evaluations.name: Internal consistency
property_evaluations.evaluation: State machine transitions, invariants, and handshake rules are mutually consistent without conflicting branches.

property_evaluations.name: Requirement atomicity
property_evaluations.evaluation: Each task (initialization, dispatch assembly, execution, retrieval, handshake evaluation, closure) is an independently verifiable atom.

property_evaluations.name: Explicit composition
property_evaluations.evaluation: Preserves strict sequencing OP1 -> OP2 -> OP3 -> OP4 -> OP5 -> OP6 and conditional loop CR6.

property_evaluations.name: State explicitness
property_evaluations.evaluation: Models active_exchange_id, current_run_nonce, gemini_preceding_response, handshake_state, and pending_obligations with explicit sources and update rules.

property_evaluations.name: Transition and termination semantics
property_evaluations.evaluation: Complete, incomplete, blocked, and failed conditions defined. Premature termination explicitly guarded.

property_evaluations.name: Structural separation
property_evaluations.evaluation: Instructions, constraints, state variables, authorities, examples, and telemetry are structurally separated into typed objects.

property_evaluations.name: Canonical exemplification
property_evaluations.evaluation: Supplies concrete canonical example EX1 illustrating trigger.json structure with embedded prior response.

property_evaluations.name: Context signal density and locality
property_evaluations.evaluation: Locality rule requires placing preceding response directly adjacent to active query; signal density excludes stale history.

property_evaluations.name: Interface congruence
property_evaluations.evaluation: Directly congruent with provided PromptGemini implementation (gemini-message-executor.js, trigger.json, config.json, runs/<run_nonce>/).

property_evaluations.name: Constraint proportionality
property_evaluations.evaluation: Constrains critical transport, context replay, and termination invariants while leaving dialogue subject-matter reasoning open.

property_evaluations.name: Specification observability
property_evaluations.evaluation: Verification checks map every requirement to observable filesystem and process evidence with explicit PASS/FAIL rules.

property_evaluations.name: Semantic projection
property_evaluations.evaluation: All procedural information projected into standardized semantic classes.

property_evaluations.name: Return-contract explicitness
property_evaluations.evaluation: Return schema defines format, mandatory fields, status semantics, and omission prohibitions.

procedure_execution_verification.prior_failure_addressed: Resolved abstract Gemini interface defect by concretely binding all dispatch and retrieval operations to gemini-message-executor.js and isolated runs/<run_nonce>/ directories.
procedure_execution_verification.handshake_closure_guaranteed: ChatGPT cannot terminate turn without explicit gemini_closure_agreed == true and empty obligations ledger.
